replaced:
Let $s$ be a subprotocol of $r$ via a subprotocol path $h_s$, let $(x,y)$ be an input
pair, let $P$ be a family of children with $P(b) = r$, and let $N$ be a node constructor
such that running $N(Q)$ on $(x,y)$ is the same as running $Q(c)$ on $(x,y)$ for a fixed
bit $c$ and every family $Q$. Let $Q$ be a rebuilding map with $Q(q_c)(b) = q_c$ and
$Q(q_c)(\neg b) = P(\neg b)$, and suppose $q$ is the result of deleting along the path
inside branch $b$: $q = P(\neg b)$ if the deletion of $h_s$ returns nothing, and
$q = N(Q(q_c))$ if it returns $q_c$. Assume that if $(x,y)$ reaches $s$ along the path
then $c \ne b$, and (inductively) that whenever the deletion of $h_s$ returns some $q'$
and $(x,y)$ does not reach $s$ along the path, $q'$ runs like $r$ on $(x,y)$. Then $q$
and $N(P)$ produce the same output on $(x,y)$.
